title: Mind-body Medicine for Patients With Malignant Hematological Diseases
official: Mind-body Medicine as a Supportive Strategy for Patients With Malignant Hematological Diseases: a Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: This randomized controlled trial aims to investigate the effectiveness of a mind-body group program as a supprtivemanagement strategy for fatigue in patients with malignant hematological diseases.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with malignant hematological diseases in complete remission after primary chemotherapy and/or radiation
* Physical and mental ability to attent 8 of 11 group units

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chemotherapy, radiation, or rehabilitation programm during the study period
* Pregnancy
* Participation in other studies with behavioral interventions during the study period
